description: Real citation failures produced by claude-sonnet-4-5 against the Altura seed library, captured 2026-08-14 before verification was added. Each case is a citation the model emitted that does not survive verification against the source clause. Failures at this rate (~6% of answered/partial) are hard to manufacture; preserve them.
source: run_answers rows from the three seed-questionnaire runs
